searchText: Should I update the EIP 7732? it seems that we are getting to a final version without any more changes? It certainly does feel like we're close. https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/issues/5333 cc <@520034910149410861>, don't think this is too serious, but it's doable though: builder creates a split 49-51 for the valid payload but votes differently on attestations and PTC, thus leading the PTC to vote for timely and attesters to vote for the payload even though it was late, with only 2% of the stake.
